body:
name: Upload to Zenodo (from data-latest)

on:
  schedule:
    # Run after the Sunday nightly dataset update (all times are UTC).
    - cron: "0 4 * * 0"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: zenodo-upload
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  zenodo-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      ZENODO_BASE_URL: https://zenodo.org
      ZENODO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ZENODO_TOKEN }}
      ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID: ${{ secrets.ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID }}
      ZENODO_COMMUNITY: ${{ secrets.ZENODO_COMMUNITY }}
      ZENODO_CREATOR_NAME: ${{ secrets.ZENODO_CREATOR_NAME }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # IMPORTANT:
      # Zenodo deposit API expects the OpenAIRE/Zenodo grant identifier format for EU grants,
      # not the grant DOI (10.3030/...).
      # This is the value your community requires.
      ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID: "10.13039/501100000780::101119635"

      # README preview files.
      # README is uploaded as 00_README.md so it appears first and is likely used
      # by Zenodo as the default preview.
      ZENODO_README_SOURCE: README.md
      ZENODO_README_ASSET: 00_README.md

      # Your README uses this local SVG badge:
      # [![DOI](.zenodo.18339068.svg)](...)
      # Upload it too so the relative image can resolve in Zenodo preview.
      ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE: .zenodo.18339068.svg
      ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET: .zenodo.18339068.svg

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Ensure tools exist (jq, curl)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y jq
          fi
          command -v curl
          command -v gh
          jq --version
          gh --version
          curl --version | head -n 2

      - name: Download latest release assets (data-latest)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "::group::Locate GitHub release 'data-latest'"
          gh release view data-latest --json tagName,name,createdAt,url,assets -q \
            '{tag:.tagName,name:.name,createdAt:.createdAt,url:.url,assets:[.assets[].name]}' | jq .
          echo "::endgroup::"

          mkdir -p artifacts

          echo "::group::Download assets (*_data.zip) from data-latest"
          gh release download data-latest --pattern "*_data.zip" --dir artifacts
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::List downloaded files"
          ls -lah artifacts
          echo "::endgroup::"

          COUNT=$(ls -1 artifacts/*_data.zip 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          if [ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: No *_data.zip files were downloaded from release 'data-latest'."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Add README and DOI badge to Zenodo artifacts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "::group::Add README"

          if [ ! -f "$ZENODO_README_SOURCE" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: README source file not found: $ZENODO_README_SOURCE"
            exit 1
          fi

          mkdir -p artifacts
          cp "$ZENODO_README_SOURCE" "artifacts/$ZENODO_README_ASSET"

          echo "Added README for Zenodo:"
          ls -lah "artifacts/$ZENODO_README_ASSET"

          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Add local DOI badge SVG"

          if [ ! -f "$ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: DOI badge SVG not found: $ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE"
            echo "Your README references this file locally, so it should be uploaded too."
            exit 1
          fi

          cp "$ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE" "artifacts/$ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET"

          echo "Added DOI badge SVG for Zenodo:"
          ls -lah "artifacts/$ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET"

          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Final artifact list"
          ls -lah artifacts
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Upload to Zenodo (robust logs + retries)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          require_env() {
            local name="$1"
            if [ -z "${!name:-}" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: Missing env var $name"
              exit 1
            fi
          }

          echo "::group::Validate required env"
          require_env ZENODO_BASE_URL
          require_env ZENODO_TOKEN
          require_env ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID
          require_env ZENODO_COMMUNITY
          require_env ZENODO_CREATOR_NAME
          require_env ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID
          require_env ZENODO_README_SOURCE
          require_env ZENODO_README_ASSET
          require_env ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE
          require_env ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET

          if ! [[ "$ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID must be numeric, got: $ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "ZENODO_BASE_URL=$ZENODO_BASE_URL"
          echo "ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID=$ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID"
          echo "ZENODO_COMMUNITY=$ZENODO_COMMUNITY"
          echo "ZENODO_CREATOR_NAME=$ZENODO_CREATOR_NAME"
          echo "ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID=$ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID"
          echo "ZENODO_README_SOURCE=$ZENODO_README_SOURCE"
          echo "ZENODO_README_ASSET=$ZENODO_README_ASSET"
          echo "ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE=$ZENODO_BADGE_SOURCE"
          echo "ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET=$ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET"
          echo "::endgroup::"

          zenodo_api() {
            # usage: zenodo_api METHOD URL [JSON_DATA]
            local method="$1"; shift
            local url="$1"; shift
            local data="${1:-}"

            local body headers http_code curl_rc
            body="$(mktemp)"
            headers="$(mktemp)"

            set +e
            if [ -n "$data" ]; then
              http_code=$(curl -sS \
                --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 \
                --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 \
                -D "$headers" -o "$body" -w "%{http_code}" \
                -X "$method" \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ZENODO_TOKEN}" \
                -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
                "$url" \
                --data-binary "$data")
              curl_rc=$?
            else
              http_code=$(curl -sS \
                --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 \
                --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 \
                -D "$headers" -o "$body" -w "%{http_code}" \
                -X "$method" \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ZENODO_TOKEN}" \
                "$url")
              curl_rc=$?
            fi
            set -e

            # IMPORTANT: print diagnostics to STDERR so they are visible even when called via $(...)
            if [ "$curl_rc" -ne 0 ] || ! [[ "${http_code:-}" =~ ^[0-9]{3}$ ]]; then
              echo "ERROR: curl failed calling Zenodo" >&2
              echo "  METHOD: $method" >&2
              echo "  URL:    $url" >&2
              echo "  curl_rc=$curl_rc http_code='${http_code:-<empty>}'" >&2
              echo "---- response headers ----" >&2
              cat "$headers" >&2 || true
              echo "---- response body ----" >&2
              cat "$body" >&2 || true
              exit 1
            fi

            if [ "$http_code" -lt 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -ge 300 ]; then
              echo "ERROR: Zenodo API returned non-2xx" >&2
              echo "  METHOD: $method" >&2
              echo "  URL:    $url" >&2
              echo "  HTTP:   $http_code" >&2
              echo "---- response headers ----" >&2
              cat "$headers" >&2 || true
              echo "---- response body ----" >&2
              cat "$body" >&2 || true
              exit 1
            fi

            cat "$body"
          }

          echo "::group::Read GitHub release info (for metadata)"
          RELEASE_JSON="$(gh release view data-latest --json tagName,url,createdAt,name)"
          echo "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq .
          RELEASE_URL="$(echo "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq -r '.url')"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(echo "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq -r '.tagName')"
          RELEASE_DATE="$(echo "$RELEASE_JSON" | jq -r '.createdAt')"
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Fetch base Zenodo deposition"
          BASE_URL="$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID"
          BASE_JSON="$(zenodo_api GET "$BASE_URL")"
          echo "$BASE_JSON" | jq '{id, state, submitted, title:.metadata.title, conceptdoi, doi, links}'
          BASE_SUBMITTED="$(echo "$BASE_JSON" | jq -r '.submitted // false')"
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Create or resume version draft"
          if [ "$BASE_SUBMITTED" != "true" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Expected base deposition to be published (submitted=true), got submitted=$BASE_SUBMITTED"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Zenodo allows only one unpublished version draft at a time. A failed
          # upload leaves that draft behind, so resume it on the next run rather
          # than attempting to create another version. This makes transient file
          # upload failures safe to rerun.
          BASE_SELF_URL="$(echo "$BASE_JSON" | jq -r '.links.self // empty')"
          DRAFT_URL="$(echo "$BASE_JSON" | jq -r '.links.latest_draft // empty')"

          if [ -n "$DRAFT_URL" ] && [ "$DRAFT_URL" != "$BASE_SELF_URL" ]; then
            echo "Found an existing unpublished version draft; resuming it: $DRAFT_URL"
          else
            echo "No outstanding draft found; creating a new version."
            # The response describes the original published record. Zenodo exposes
            # the actual new draft through links.latest_draft, not the response id.
            NEW_VERSION_RESPONSE="$(zenodo_api POST "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$ZENODO_DEPOSITION_ID/actions/newversion")"
            DRAFT_URL="$(echo "$NEW_VERSION_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.links.latest_draft // empty')"
          fi

          if [ -z "$DRAFT_URL" ] || [ "$DRAFT_URL" = "null" ] || [ "$DRAFT_URL" = "$BASE_SELF_URL" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Zenodo did not provide an unpublished version draft."
            echo "Base deposition links:"
            echo "$BASE_JSON" | jq '.links'
            exit 1
          fi

          TARGET_JSON="$(zenodo_api GET "$DRAFT_URL")"
          TARGET_ID="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r '.id // empty')"
          TARGET_SUBMITTED="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r '.submitted // false')"
          if [ -z "$TARGET_ID" ] || [ "$TARGET_SUBMITTED" = "true" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: latest_draft is not an editable unpublished deposition."
            echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq '{id, state, submitted, links}'
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Using draft deposition id: $TARGET_ID"
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Get bucket URL"
          BUCKET="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r '.links.bucket')"
          if [ -z "$BUCKET" ] || [ "$BUCKET" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Bucket missing in newversion response; refetching deposition..."
            TARGET_JSON="$(zenodo_api GET "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID")"
            BUCKET="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r '.links.bucket')"
          fi

          if [ -z "$BUCKET" ] || [ "$BUCKET" = "null" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Could not determine bucket URL"
            echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq .
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Bucket: $BUCKET"
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Inspect files already present in the draft"
          TARGET_JSON="$(zenodo_api GET "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID")"
          echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r '.files[]? | "\(.id)  \(.filename)  \(.filesize) bytes"' || true
          echo "Existing files are kept when their filename, size, and checksum match the local artifact."
          echo "This lets a later weekly run resume a timed-out upload without re-uploading completed files."
          echo "::endgroup::"

          # Update metadata BEFORE uploading files (avoids Zenodo validation complaining about files state)
          echo "::group::Update metadata (preserve + enforce grant + force publication_date + fix dates)"
          TODAY_UTC="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
          PUBDATE="$TODAY_UTC"
          TITLE="Stablecoin DeFi Hourly Dataset - ${TODAY_UTC}"

          DESC="$(cat <<EOF
          Automatically uploaded weekly snapshot from the GitHub rolling release \`${RELEASE_TAG}\`.

          Source release: ${RELEASE_URL}
          Release created at: ${RELEASE_DATE}

          Files included: README, DOI badge SVG, AAVE, Uniswap, Curve, ETH blocks mapping and Chainlink data ZIP archives.
          EOF
          )"

          CURRENT_DRAFT="$(zenodo_api GET "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID")"

          NEW_METADATA_ONLY="$(echo "$CURRENT_DRAFT" | jq \
            --arg title "$TITLE" \
            --arg desc "$DESC" \
            --arg pubdate "$PUBDATE" \
            --arg community "$ZENODO_COMMUNITY" \
            --arg grant "$ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID" \
            '
            .metadata
            | .title = $title
            | .description = $desc
            | .publication_date = $pubdate

            # Ensure community is present
            | .communities = ((.communities // []) | map(select(.identifier != $community)) + [{identifier: $community}])

            # IMPORTANT: remove invalid grant DOI form if it exists, then enforce required OpenAIRE grant id
            | .grants = ([{id: $grant}])

            # Fix invalid "dates" entries (Zenodo requires start/end for collected)
            | .dates = (
                ((.dates // []) | map(select(.type != "collected")))
                + [{type:"collected", start:$pubdate, end:$pubdate}]
              )
            ')"

          METADATA_PAYLOAD="$(jq -n --argjson md "$NEW_METADATA_ONLY" '{metadata: $md}')"

          echo "Metadata payload (sanity check):"
          echo "$METADATA_PAYLOAD" | jq '{publication_date: .metadata.publication_date, dates: .metadata.dates, grants: .metadata.grants, communities: .metadata.communities}'

          UPDATED="$(zenodo_api PUT "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID" "$METADATA_PAYLOAD")"
          echo "Zenodo response after PUT:"
          echo "$UPDATED" | jq '{id, state, submitted, publication_date: .metadata.publication_date}'
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Upload files"

          README_ARTIFACT="artifacts/$ZENODO_README_ASSET"
          BADGE_ARTIFACT="artifacts/$ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET"

          if [ ! -f "$README_ARTIFACT" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: README artifact missing: $README_ARTIFACT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -f "$BADGE_ARTIFACT" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: DOI badge SVG artifact missing: $BADGE_ARTIFACT"
            exit 1
          fi

          mapfile -t ZIP_FILES < <(find artifacts -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*_data.zip' | sort)

          if [ "${#ZIP_FILES[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: No *_data.zip files found in artifacts."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Upload order matters for preview behavior.
          # Zenodo does not expose a documented API flag for "default preview file",
          # so README is uploaded first and named 00_README.md.
          UPLOAD_FILES=("$README_ARTIFACT" "$BADGE_ARTIFACT" "${ZIP_FILES[@]}")

          echo "Upload order:"
          printf ' - %s\n' "${UPLOAD_FILES[@]}"

          upload_file() {
            local f="$1" name size local_md5 existing_size existing_checksum existing_id body headers http_code curl_rc response attempt delay
            name="$(basename "$f")"
            size="$(stat -c%s "$f")"
            local_md5="$(md5sum "$f" | awk '{print $1}')"

            # A timed-out request can still have completed at Zenodo.  Check the
            # draft first so a resumed weekly job never needlessly uploads it again.
            TARGET_JSON="$(zenodo_api GET "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID")"
            existing_size="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r --arg name "$name" '.files[]? | select(.filename == $name) | .filesize')"
            existing_checksum="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r --arg name "$name" '.files[]? | select(.filename == $name) | .checksum')"
            existing_checksum="${existing_checksum#md5:}"
            existing_id="$(echo "$TARGET_JSON" | jq -r --arg name "$name" '.files[]? | select(.filename == $name) | .id')"
            if [ "$existing_size" = "$size" ] && [ "$existing_checksum" = "$local_md5" ]; then
              echo "Already uploaded with matching checksum; skipping $name."
              return 0
            fi
            if [ -n "$existing_id" ]; then
              echo "Deleting incomplete or stale $name before retrying its upload."
              zenodo_api DELETE "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID/files/$existing_id" >/dev/null
            fi

            # The failed run timed out while uploading the 182 MB Curve archive.
            # Give one transfer up to 30 minutes, then make at most two spaced
            # retries for timeouts and server-side/transient responses.
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              echo "Uploading (attempt $attempt/3): $name ($size bytes) -> $BUCKET/$name"
              body="$(mktemp)"
              headers="$(mktemp)"

              set +e
              http_code=$(curl -sS \
                --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 1800 \
                -D "$headers" -o "$body" -w "%{http_code}" \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ZENODO_TOKEN}" \
                --upload-file "$f" \
                "$BUCKET/$name")
              curl_rc=$?
              set -e

              if [ "$curl_rc" -eq 0 ] && [[ "${http_code:-}" =~ ^[0-9]{3}$ ]] \
                && [ "$http_code" -ge 200 ] && [ "$http_code" -lt 300 ]; then
                echo "Uploaded OK: $name (HTTP $http_code)"
                return 0
              fi

              response="$(cat "$body" 2>/dev/null || true)"
              retryable=false
              if [ "$curl_rc" -ne 0 ] \
                || [[ "$http_code" =~ ^(408|429|500|502|503|504)$ ]] \
                || { [ "$http_code" = "400" ] && [[ "$response" == *"The file upload transfer failed, please try again."* ]]; }; then
                retryable=true
              fi
              if [ "$retryable" = true ] && [ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]; then
                delay=$((300 * 3 ** (attempt - 1)))
                echo "Zenodo transfer failed transiently; retrying in ${delay}s..." >&2
                sleep "$delay"
                continue
              fi

              echo "ERROR: Upload failed for $name" >&2
              echo "  curl_rc=$curl_rc http_code='${http_code:-<empty>}'" >&2
              echo "---- response headers ----" >&2
              cat "$headers" >&2 || true
              echo "---- response body ----" >&2
              cat "$body" >&2 || true
              return 1
            done
          }

          for f in "${UPLOAD_FILES[@]}"; do
            [ -f "$f" ] || continue
            upload_file "$f"
          done
          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Pre-publish validation"
          CHECK="$(zenodo_api GET "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID")"

          echo "Metadata check:"
          echo "$CHECK" | jq '.metadata | {title, publication_date, dates, grants, communities}'

          echo "Files check:"
          echo "$CHECK" | jq -r '.files[]? | "\(.filename)  \(.filesize) bytes"'

          for f in "${UPLOAD_FILES[@]}"; do
            name="$(basename "$f")"
            local_size="$(stat -c%s "$f")"
            local_md5="$(md5sum "$f" | awk '{print $1}')"
            zenodo_size="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r --arg name "$name" '.files[]? | select(.filename == $name) | .filesize')"
            zenodo_checksum="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r --arg name "$name" '.files[]? | select(.filename == $name) | .checksum')"
            zenodo_checksum="${zenodo_checksum#md5:}"
            if [ "$zenodo_size" != "$local_size" ] || [ "$zenodo_checksum" != "$local_md5" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: $name is missing or differs from the local artifact on Zenodo." >&2
              echo "  expected: size=$local_size md5=$local_md5" >&2
              echo "  actual:   size=${zenodo_size:-missing} md5=${zenodo_checksum:-missing}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done

          PUBDATE_ON_ZENODO="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r '.metadata.publication_date // ""')"
          if [ -z "$PUBDATE_ON_ZENODO" ] || [ "$PUBDATE_ON_ZENODO" = "null" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: publication_date is missing on Zenodo draft; refusing to publish."
            exit 1
          fi

          GRANT_OK="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r --arg g "$ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID" 'any(.metadata.grants[]?; .id == $g)')"
          if [ "$GRANT_OK" != "true" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Required grant is missing on Zenodo draft; refusing to publish."
            echo "Expected: $ZENODO_REQUIRED_GRANT_ID"
            exit 1
          fi

          README_OK="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r --arg fn "$ZENODO_README_ASSET" 'any(.files[]?; .filename == $fn)')"
          if [ "$README_OK" != "true" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: README file is missing from Zenodo draft; refusing to publish."
            echo "Expected README asset: $ZENODO_README_ASSET"
            echo "$CHECK" | jq '.files'
            exit 1
          fi

          BADGE_OK="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r --arg fn "$ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET" 'any(.files[]?; .filename == $fn)')"
          if [ "$BADGE_OK" != "true" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: DOI badge SVG file is missing from Zenodo draft; refusing to publish."
            echo "Expected badge asset: $ZENODO_BADGE_ASSET"
            echo "$CHECK" | jq '.files'
            exit 1
          fi

          FIRST_FILE="$(echo "$CHECK" | jq -r '.files[0].filename // ""')"
          echo "First file reported by Zenodo: $FIRST_FILE"

          if [ "$FIRST_FILE" != "$ZENODO_README_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "::warning::README is uploaded, but Zenodo did not report it as the first file. Default preview cannot be fully guaranteed by the API."
          fi

          echo "::endgroup::"

          echo "::group::Publish"
          PUB="$(zenodo_api POST "$ZENODO_BASE_URL/api/deposit/depositions/$TARGET_ID/actions/publish")"
          echo "$PUB" | jq '{id, state, submitted, doi, conceptdoi, links}'
          echo "Published record page: $(echo "$PUB" | jq -r '.links.html // empty')"
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Workflow completed at: $(date -u)"
          echo "If it failed, inspect the grouped logs above (Zenodo error bodies print to STDERR)."
